info.title: WizardGang Architecture Demo REST API
info.description: Executable OpenAPI 3.1 contract for the current v1 REST and assurance interfaces. Reporting response schemas are mechanically synchronized from the canonical assurance contracts.

tags.name: Records
tags.description: D1-backed demonstration records with public reads and visitor-scoped authenticated writes.

tags.name: Assurance
tags.description: Public current-state assurance reporting backed by the canonical reporting contract.

get.description: List at most 100 records. Anonymous requests read the public namespace; an identity-derived token reads its visitor sandbox.

parameters.name: namespace
parameters.description: Anonymous reads are fixed to public. Operators may select a namespace; this value is ignored for identity-derived visitor tokens.

post.description: Create a new key in the authorized namespace. Returns 409 when that key already exists; use PUT to replace it.

Location.description: Canonical record URL within the authorized namespace.

parameters.name: namespace
parameters.description: Anonymous reads are fixed to public. Operators may select a namespace; this value is ignored for identity-derived visitor tokens.

put.description: Create the requested key or replace its complete value in the authorized namespace.

201.description: Record created at the requested key

get.description: Returns the current assurance registry and stable collection routes. Family-specific aggregate record arrays are not embedded in this discovery response.
Returns the current shared assurance query-result contract.
Returns the current shared assurance query-result contract with registry-supported compliance filters.
Returns the current query-result envelope with exactly one canonical record.
Returns the current shared assurance query-result contract with current risk filters.
Returns the current shared assurance query-result contract.
Returns the current shared assurance query-result contract.

BearerToken.description: A ten-minute demo token issued after provider sign-in. Its demo:write permission is restricted to the caller's server-derived visitor sandbox. A managed operator credential is also accepted but never exposed by the public explorer.

ETag.description: Weak ETag for the current assurance representation.

AssuranceLimit.name: limit
AssuranceLimit.description: Optional page size from 1 to 100. When cursor is provided without limit, the default is 50.

AssuranceCursor.name: cursor
AssuranceCursor.description: Stable canonical record ID from the previous page.

InvalidRequest.description: Invalid record, identifier, or JSON request.

AuthenticationRequired.description: A valid bearer credential is required.

PermissionDenied.description: The authenticated principal lacks the required permission.

example.message: POST creates a new resource. Use PUT to replace an existing key.

PayloadTooLarge.description: The JSON request exceeds 16 KiB or the serialized record value exceeds 4096 bytes.

NotFound.description: The requested canonical record was not found.

Unavailable.description: The demo is intentionally offline or a required registered source is unavailable.

AssuranceInvalidRequest.description: Invalid or unsupported assurance query parameter.

AssuranceRepresentationRejected.description: Unsupported assurance representation requested. The current contract serves application/json only.

key.description: When supplied, must equal the key path parameter.
